label: Кнопки App Store + Google Play
description: Блок сторов: две кнопки приложений по центру, на мобильном в столбик.
pug:
.iq-store-buttons--stor.center.iq-store-buttons
    a(href="{{ app_href }}" target="_blank")
        img.iq-store-buttons--a-app(src="{{ app_img }}" alt="App Store")
    a(href="{{ google_href }}" target="_blank")
        img.iq-store-buttons--a-google(src="{{ google_img }}" alt="Google Play")
styl:
.iq-store-buttons--stor
  width 100% !important
  max-width: 450px
  margin 0 auto
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    width 100% !important
.iq-store-buttons--a-app
  display inline-block
  padding 0 15px 15px 15px
  max-width 120px
  height 40px !important
  float: none
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    display block !important
    float none !important
    margin 0 auto !important
.iq-store-buttons--a-google
  display inline-block
  max-width 135px
  height 40px !important
  float: none
  padding 0 15px 15px 15px
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    display block !important
    float none !important
    margin 0 auto !important
